elements.text:
Biome Scry asks the world where something is. Casting it lays out every land the world knows of, and the bar at the top searches the list by name.

  Double-click one and the spell goes looking. What comes back is a trail of green light pointing the way, and it is a long way more often than not.

  Follow it far enough and the trail becomes a cross laid on the ground. Stand on the cross and the spell is spent.

  This mechanic's visuals will not work well with shaders.
